_note: Round 7 (X posts 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-30, Seeker's set). stance4 is the round 6 question verbatim. 'use' is new; its labels mirror Seeker's applied/commentary/academic reference labels.

args: stance=What is the author's stance on whether AI could be conscious? reject = dismisses it; curious = unsure, open or just interested; serious = treats it as a real possibility or deserving moral concern; reporting = only summarizes or relays news or research without giving their own view

use=How does the post deal with AI consciousness? applied = the author made or changed something concrete (a guardrail, persona rule, model-retirement decision, memory setting, or how an agent may run) because of their stance on AI consciousness; commentary = reacts to someone else's product or policy decision (for example Anthropic's end-conversation feature or usage policy, a model-welfare line in an S-1 filing, or a system prompt rule); academic = purely academic or philosophical discussion
